digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework (pydantic-ai seam and multi-provider routing)
propositions: The LLM provider seam is implemented via pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook to enable pluggable provider implementations without modifying rebar's core runner
A two-tier support model (first_class for native Anthropic and Bedrock, best_effort for OpenAI-compatible proxies) must be documented with explicit guarantees and limitations for each tier
Capability decisions derive exclusively from ModelProfile field presence rather than provider-name string matching to avoid brittle provider-specific logic
The provider registry and seam test form a load-bearing architectural guard preventing silent provider fallback and prefix-matching regressions
Bedrock uses ambient AWS credentials and inference-profile model IDs, never rebar-managed secrets, with mandatory region pre-check raising LLMConfigError
An ADR documenting all rejected alternatives (LiteLLM in-process, gateway-fronted Bedrock, cross-provider fallback, SSM API keys) must accompany production docs to prevent re-proposal
